scope: 236 static opaque PNG originals; CLIC150 followed by Commons86; retained measurements, with no recompression during restructuring

datasets.name: CLIC 2020 test
datasets.selection: 75 mobile + 75 professional; original PNG <= 5,000,000 bytes; deterministic hash-ranked selection; no resizing or re-encoding

datasets.name: Wikimedia Commons
datasets.selection: All eligible cached originals when user stopped downloads; search-topic and download-order biased, not uniformly random; 15 transparent and 2 unsupported ICC candidates excluded before compression

image_size_bytes.values: Encoded original/local/TinyPNG file sizes; integers, not displayed KB/KiB

quality.dssim_mean: <=1,000,000 pixels: whole-image score; larger images: area-weighted mean of full-resolution 512x512 tiles, including edge tiles
quality.dssim_peak: <=1,000,000 pixels: same as mean; larger images: maximum 512x512 tile score
quality.rendering: Each image independently converted from its embedded ICC to sRGB by Pillow/LittleCMS; relative colorimetric intent=1, flags=0; standard/untagged sRGB otherwise; display orientation; no resize
quality.source: Independent scores on color-managed rendered images; not CLI self-reported quality
quality.reuse_basis: Before cleanup, all 236 optimized outputs were verified byte-for-byte identical to the independently scored files; export hashes were verified
quality.limitations: Tiled DSSIM is not equivalent to whole-image multiscale DSSIM; worst tile does not measure every possible local defect; these metrics do not guarantee visual indistinguishability

local_ms.source: Optimized CLI compression-call timer recorded during the full 236-image regression
local_ms.meaning: Single measured compression call, including decode, candidate search, quality checks and encoding; excludes CLI input-file read/output-file write, process startup and web transfer/queue
local_ms.limitations: Observed latency under concurrent regression load, not isolated serial timing; compilation and fixture tests overlapped with early CLIC records

tinypng.source: Actual TinyPNG website outputs from the same original bytes; format conversion disabled
tinypng.timing: Not available; no fabricated website encoding time

errors.convention: Keep failed rows; use null for unavailable measurements and add error; never encode failure as zero or omit a failed sample

image_source.url: Original image download URL, or dataset ZIP URL when archive_path is present
image_source.archive_path: Optional ZIP member path; required for CLIC images
image_source.sha256: SHA256 of original encoded image bytes; stable row identifier

retained_artifacts: Only benchmark.json and benchmark.meta.json are retained from the validation runs. Original/output images, ZIPs, scripts, raw logs and reports have been removed; rerunning requires obtaining the original files and matching the recorded engine and scoring method.
